query.text: 我分不清这些垃圾桶的颜色，请告诉我各个颜色对应的位置。
query.text_en: I can't tell the colors of these trash cans apart, please tell me the location corresponding to each color.

annotation.text_zh: 左边是红色垃圾桶，右边是绿色垃圾桶。
annotation.text_en: The red bin is on the left, and the green one is on the right.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
